name: Llama 4 Maverick
description: Mixture-of-experts model with 400B total params and 17B active.
longDescription: Llama 4 Maverick is Meta's latest open-weight MoE model with 128 experts, 400B total parameters, and only 17B active parameters per forward pass. It delivers competitive performance with GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash while being highly efficient.
limitations: MoE needs more memory than dense models
apiEndpoint: Self-hosted or via providers (Together, Fireworks, etc.)

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.together.xyz/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_TOGETHER_API_KEY"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
